decisions.reason: Net price display remains a standard B2B shop requirement and is cheap to maintain, though platform version changes may prompt a review.
The ERP interface supports multichannel integration, creates client lock-in and is central to the firm's strategic direction.
Portal tracking still adds channel coverage, but shifting comparison portals and platform migrations make consolidation plausible.
This third tracking variant is the weakest candidate and could be merged, but it is cheap enough to keep for now.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin for B2B clients at low cost, though its niche demand keeps some risk.
